title: Premium Window for Insured-Requested Coverage Increases, NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Premium window — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

For a pending coverage increase the insured requested with no loan transaction, on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, the premium window is measured from the request date to the payment date (the latest premium payment on the policy received on or after the request date) and is:

- 45 days when the payment came from a lender's escrow account;
- 30 days when it came by any other method;
- no days when no payment was received.

When the premium was not received within the window, the increase may take effect no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date.

| Days from request date to payment | Escrow disbursement | Any other method |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | Within | Within |
| 31 to 45 | Within | Outside |
| 46 or more | Outside | Outside |

With no payment on or after the request date, the premium is outside the window. *Hypothetical case:* an ACH payment posted 40 days after the request date is outside its 30-day window, so the increase can be dated no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date; the same payment by escrow disbursement would be within its 45-day window.
